q: Which angel did God send to Mary with news of Jesus' birth?
why: Gabriel had also visited Zechariah.
quote: God sent the angel Gabriel to a town in Galilee called Nazareth

q: In which town did Mary live when the angel Gabriel visited her?
why: Nazareth was a town in Galilee.
quote: to a town in Galilee called Nazareth

q: When the angel came to Mary, to whom was she engaged?
why: Joseph was of the house of David.
quote: pledged in marriage to a man named Joseph

q: What name did the angel Gabriel tell Mary to give her son?
why: He would be called the Son of the Most High.
quote: and you are to give Him the name Jesus.

q: The angel told Mary that her son's kingdom would do what?
why: He would reign forever.
quote: His kingdom will never end!

q: When Mary asked how this could happen, the angel said no word from God will ever do what?
why: Nothing is impossible for God.
quote: For no word from God will ever fail.

q: How did Mary answer the angel Gabriel's message?
why: She trusted God's plan.
quote: “I am the Lord’s servant,” Mary answered.

q: Why did Joseph and Mary travel to Bethlehem before Jesus was born?
why: Caesar Augustus had ordered a census.
quote: He went there to register with Mary

q: Where did Mary lay baby Jesus after He was born?
wrong: In a bed at the inn
why: A manger is a feeding trough for animals.
quote: and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.

q: Why was baby Jesus laid in a manger?
a: There was no room in the inn
why: The King of kings was born in a humble place.
quote: because there was no room for them in the inn.

q: On the night Jesus was born, who were watching their flocks in the nearby fields?
why: They were the first to hear the news.
quote: And there were shepherds residing in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks by night.

q: On the night Jesus was born, what did the angel say he brought the shepherds?
why: The news was for all the people.
quote: For behold, I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people

q: On the night Jesus was born, what did the heavenly host say as they praised God?
a: Glory to God in the highest
why: They also sang of peace on earth.
quote: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to men on whom His favor rests!

q: After the angels left, what did the shepherds find when they hurried to Bethlehem?
a: The Baby lying in the manger
why: It was just as the angel had said.
quote: So they hurried off and found Mary and Joseph and the Baby, who was lying in the manger.

q: How old was Jesus when He stayed behind in Jerusalem after the Passover?
why: His family went up for the feast every year.
quote: And when He was twelve years old

q: After the Passover feast, who stayed behind in Jerusalem without His parents knowing?
why: His parents thought He was with the group.
quote: the boy Jesus remained behind in Jerusalem, but His parents were unaware He had stayed.

q: After how many days did Mary and Joseph find the twelve-year-old Jesus?
why: They searched anxiously.
quote: Finally, after three days they found Him in the temple courts

q: Where did Mary and Joseph find the twelve-year-old Jesus?
a: In the temple with the teachers
why: He was listening and asking questions.
quote: they found Him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers

q: How did people in the temple react to the twelve-year-old Jesus?
why: His answers astonished them.
quote: And all who heard Him were astounded at His understanding and His answers.

q: As young Jesus grew up, He grew in wisdom and stature and in favor with whom?
why: He grew up in Nazareth.
quote: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.

q: By the Lake of Gennesaret, whose boat did Jesus sit in to teach the crowd?
why: He asked Simon to push out a little from shore.
quote: Jesus got into the boat belonging to Simon

q: After teaching from Simon's boat, what did Jesus tell Simon to do?
a: Let down nets in deep water
why: Simon obeyed even though he was tired.
quote: Put out into deep water and let down your nets for a catch.

q: Before Jesus told him to fish again, how had Simon's night of fishing gone?
why: They had worked hard all night.
quote: we have worked hard all night without catching anything.

q: When Simon let down his nets as Jesus said, what happened?
a: So many fish the nets tore
why: Both boats were filled.
quote: they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to tear.

q: After the huge catch of fish, what did Simon Peter say about himself?
why: He fell at Jesus' knees.
quote: for I am a sinful man.

q: After the huge catch, Jesus told Simon that from now on he would catch what?
why: Simon would bring people to God.
quote: From now on you will catch men.

q: After the miraculous catch, what did the fishermen leave to follow Jesus?
why: Following Jesus mattered most.
quote: they left everything and followed Him.

q: Which question led Jesus to tell the story of the Good Samaritan?
why: An expert in the law asked it.
quote: And who is my neighbor?

q: In the Good Samaritan story, what happened to the man going down to Jericho?
a: Robbers beat him and left him
why: He was left half dead.
quote: when he fell into the hands of robbers. They stripped him, beat him, and went away, leaving him half dead.

q: In the Good Samaritan story, what did the priest do when he saw the hurt man?
a: Passed by on the other side
why: He did not stop to help.
quote: but when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

q: In Jesus' story, who stopped and had compassion on the hurt man by the road?
why: The one people least expected showed love.
quote: But when a Samaritan on a journey came upon him, he looked at him and had compassion.

q: In the Good Samaritan story, what did the Samaritan pour on the man's wounds?
why: He bandaged the wounds himself.
quote: and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine.

q: Where did the Good Samaritan take the hurt man?
why: He put him on his own animal.
quote: brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

q: At the end of the Good Samaritan story, what did Jesus tell the expert in the law?
why: Being a neighbor means showing mercy.
quote: Go and do likewise.

q: Which woman welcomed Jesus into her home in a village?
why: Her sister Mary lived there too.
quote: a woman named Martha welcomed Him into her home.

q: While Jesus visited Martha's home, what did her sister Mary do?
why: She wanted to hear His message.
quote: who sat at the Lord’s feet listening to His message.

q: Why was Martha upset when Jesus visited her home?
a: Mary left her to serve alone
why: She was busy with all the preparations.
quote: do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone?

q: Jesus told Martha she was worried and upset about what?
why: Only one thing was really needed.
quote: you are worried and upset about many things.

q: When Martha complained, Jesus said Mary had chosen what?
why: Listening to Jesus would not be taken from her.
quote: Mary has chosen the good portion

q: What was the name of Martha's sister who sat listening to Jesus?
why: She chose to listen.
quote: She had a sister named Mary

q: In Jesus' parable of the lost sheep, how many sheep did the man have?
why: He lost just one.
quote: if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them

q: In the parable of the lost sheep, what does the shepherd leave to look for the lost one?
why: Every single sheep matters to him.
quote: does not leave the ninety-nine in the pasture and go after the one that is lost

q: In the parable of the lost sheep, how does the shepherd carry the sheep home?
why: He carries it joyfully.
quote: he joyfully puts it on his shoulders

q: In the parable of the lost sheep, what does the shepherd tell his friends when he gets home?
why: He found what was lost.
quote: Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep!

q: In the parable of the lost sheep, heaven rejoices over one sinner who does what?
why: God loves to find the lost.
quote: there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents

q: In Jesus' parable of the prodigal son, what did the younger son ask his father for?
why: He wanted his inheritance early.
quote: Father, give me my share of the estate.

q: In the parable of the prodigal son, how did the younger son waste his money?
why: He went to a distant country.
quote: where he squandered his wealth in wild living.

q: After spending all his money, what job did the prodigal son have to take?
why: A severe famine came.
quote: who sent him into his fields to feed the pigs.

q: When the father saw his lost son coming home, what did he do?
a: Ran to him and kissed him
why: He was filled with compassion.
quote: He ran to his son, embraced him, and kissed him.

q: What did the father put on his son who came home?
a: The best robe, a ring, sandals
why: He welcomed him back as a son.
quote: Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.

q: To celebrate his son's return, what did the father have killed for the feast?
why: It was time to celebrate.
quote: Bring the fattened calf and kill it.

q: How did the older brother react to the party for his returning brother?
why: He refused to go in.
quote: The older son became angry and refused to go in.

q: What was Zacchaeus's job?
why: He was very wealthy.
quote: a chief tax collector, who was very wealthy.

q: Why couldn't Zacchaeus see Jesus over the crowd?
why: He was small in stature.
quote: because he was small in stature.

q: What did Zacchaeus climb so he could see Jesus?
why: Jesus was about to pass that way.
quote: So he ran on ahead and climbed a sycamore tree to see Him

q: What did Jesus say when He saw Zacchaeus up in the tree?
a: Hurry down, I'll stay at your house
why: Jesus wanted to be his guest.
quote: Zacchaeus, hurry down, for I must stay at your house today.

q: Why did people grumble when Jesus went to Zacchaeus's house?
why: Jesus came for sinners.
quote: He has gone to be the guest of a sinful man!

q: After meeting Jesus, how much of his possessions did Zacchaeus give to the poor?
why: Meeting Jesus changed him.
quote: half of my possessions I give to the poor

q: After meeting Zacchaeus, Jesus said He came to seek and save whom?
why: That is why He came.
quote: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.

q: Which two disciples did Jesus send to prepare the Passover meal?
why: It would be His last supper with them.
quote: Jesus sent Peter and John

q: At the Last Supper, what did Jesus say He had eagerly desired?
a: To eat this Passover with them
why: His suffering was near.
quote: I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before My suffering.

q: At the Last Supper, what did Jesus say about the bread He broke?
a: This is My body, given for you
why: He would give His body on the cross.
quote: This is My body, given for you

q: At the Last Supper, Jesus told His disciples to do this in remembrance of whom?
why: The Lord's Supper remembers Him.
quote: do this in remembrance of Me.

q: At the Last Supper, what did Jesus call the cup?
a: The new covenant in My blood
why: His blood was poured out for them.
quote: This cup is the new covenant in My blood

q: Jesus told Peter he would deny Him how many times before the rooster crowed?
why: It happened just as Jesus said.
quote: the rooster will not crow today until you have denied three times that you know Me.

q: After Jesus was taken to the high priest's house, where did Peter sit?
a: By a fire in the courtyard
why: He followed at a distance.
quote: When those present had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat down among them.

q: In the high priest's courtyard, who first said Peter had been with Jesus?
why: She saw him in the firelight.
quote: A servant girl saw him seated in the firelight

q: When the servant girl said Peter was with Jesus, what did Peter say?
a: Woman, I do not know Him
why: Peter was afraid.
quote: “Woman, I do not know Him,” he said.

q: What happened while Peter was still denying Jesus the third time?
why: Jesus' words came true.
quote: While he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.

q: When the rooster crowed after Peter's denial, what did Jesus do?
why: Peter remembered Jesus' words.
quote: And the Lord turned and looked at Peter.

q: After denying Jesus three times, what did Peter do?
why: He was heartbroken.
quote: And he went outside and wept bitterly.

q: What was the place called where Jesus was crucified?
why: Criminals were crucified beside Him.
quote: When they came to the place called The Skull

q: On the cross, what did Jesus pray for the people crucifying Him?
why: They did not know what they were doing.
quote: Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.

q: On the cross, what did Jesus promise the criminal who asked to be remembered?
wrong: You will see Me in Galilee
why: Jesus forgave him.
quote: Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in Paradise.

q: In Luke, what did Jesus call out just before He breathed His last?
a: Into Your hands I commit My Spirit
why: He gave His life to the Father.
quote: Father, into Your hands I commit My Spirit.

q: When the women came to Jesus' tomb early Sunday morning, what did they find?
why: Jesus was not there.
quote: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb

q: At the empty tomb, what did the two men in shining clothes ask the women?
a: Why look for the living among the dead?
why: Jesus was alive.
quote: Why do you look for the living among the dead?

q: When Peter ran to Jesus' tomb, what did he see inside?
why: He went away wondering.
quote: And after bending down and seeing only the linen cloths

q: On the day Jesus rose, which village were two of His followers walking to?
why: They talked about all that had happened.
quote: That same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus

q: On the road to Emmaus, who came up and walked with the two disciples?
why: They did not know it was Him.
quote: Jesus Himself came up and walked along with them.

q: Why didn't the two disciples on the road to Emmaus recognize Jesus?
a: Their eyes were kept from it
why: God kept them from knowing Him yet.
quote: But their eyes were kept from recognizing Him.

q: What was the name of one of the two disciples on the road to Emmaus?
why: He thought the stranger had not heard the news.
quote: One of them, named Cleopas

q: At Emmaus, when did the two disciples recognize Jesus?
why: Then He disappeared from their sight.
quote: and how they had recognized Jesus in the breaking of the bread.

q: Remembering their walk to Emmaus, how did the two disciples say their hearts had felt?
why: Jesus had opened the Scriptures to them.
quote: Were not our hearts burning within us as He spoke with us on the road

q: After recognizing Jesus at Emmaus, where did the two disciples go right away?
why: They had to tell the others.
quote: And they got up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem.

q: In Luke, who was the priest whose wife Elizabeth had no children?
why: They were both old and righteous.
quote: there was a priest named Zechariah

q: What name did the angel tell Zechariah to give his son?
why: He would become John the Baptist.
quote: and you are to give him the name John.

q: Because Zechariah did not believe the angel's message, what happened to him?
why: He stayed silent until the promise came true.
quote: And now you will be silent and unable to speak until the day this comes to pass

q: The angel told Mary which relative of hers was also expecting a son in her old age?
why: She was in her sixth month.
quote: Look, even Elizabeth your relative has conceived a son in her old age

q: How does Mary's song of praise in Luke begin?
wrong: Glory to God in the highest
why: She rejoiced in God her Savior.
quote: My soul magnifies the Lord

q: Which Roman ruler ordered the census that brought Joseph to Bethlehem?
why: Everyone had to register in his own town.
quote: a decree went out from Caesar Augustus

q: What did the angel tell the shepherds was born in the city of David?
why: It was news for all people.
quote: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!

q: After the shepherds' visit, what did Mary do with all these things?
why: She thought deeply about them.
quote: But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.

q: For which feast did Jesus' parents go to Jerusalem every year?
why: They went when Jesus was twelve too.
quote: Every year His parents went to Jerusalem for the Feast of the Passover.

q: By which lake was Jesus standing when He called Simon to follow Him?
why: It is another name for the Sea of Galilee.
quote: while Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret

q: Who were Simon's fishing partners, the sons of Zebedee?
why: They were amazed at the catch too.
quote: and so were his partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee.

q: What did the expert in the law ask Jesus just before the Good Samaritan story?
wrong: Why He healed on the Sabbath
why: He wanted to test Jesus.
quote: what must I do to inherit eternal life?

q: In the Good Samaritan story, who was the second man to pass by the hurt traveler?
why: He also passed by on the other side.
quote: So too, when a Levite came to that spot and saw him, he passed by on the other side.

q: After the Good Samaritan story, who did the expert say had been a neighbor to the hurt man?
why: A neighbor is anyone who shows mercy.
quote: The one who showed him mercy

q: In the parable of the prodigal son, what did the hungry son long to eat?
why: No one gave him anything.
quote: He longed to fill his belly with the pods the pigs were eating

q: In the parable of the prodigal son, why did the father say they should celebrate?
a: He was lost and is found
why: His son was dead and is alive again.
quote: He was lost and is found!

q: Zacchaeus promised to repay anyone he had cheated how many times over?
why: His life was changed by Jesus.
quote: and if I have cheated anyone, I will repay it fourfold.

q: After Zacchaeus changed his ways, what did Jesus say had come to his house?
why: Zacchaeus was a son of Abraham too.
quote: Today salvation has come to this house

q: In the high priest's courtyard, why did a man insist Peter must have been with Jesus?
wrong: He wore a robe like Jesus
why: Peter denied it a third time.
quote: for he too is a Galilean.

q: What did the criminal on the cross ask of Jesus?
why: Jesus promised him Paradise.
quote: Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!

q: In Luke, what happened to the sun and the temple veil when Jesus was dying?
why: Creation itself responded.
quote: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn down the middle.

q: In Luke, what did the two men at the empty tomb tell the women about Jesus?
a: He is not here; He has risen!
why: Jesus had told them He would rise.
quote: He is not here; He has risen!

q: When the women told the apostles Jesus had risen, how did the apostles respond?
why: It sounded like nonsense to them.
quote: and they did not believe the women.

q: At Emmaus, what did the two disciples urge the stranger to do?
why: It was nearly evening.
quote: Stay with us, for it is nearly evening

q: On the road to Emmaus, where did Jesus begin explaining the Scriptures about Himself?
a: With Moses and all the Prophets
why: The whole Old Testament points to Him.
quote: And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, He explained to them what was written in all the Scriptures about Himself.

q: At the end of Luke, what happened while Jesus was blessing His disciples?
a: He was carried up into heaven
why: This was His ascension.
quote: While He was blessing them, He left them and was carried up into heaven.

q: To which priestly division did Zechariah, John the Baptist's father, belong?
why: His wife Elizabeth was a daughter of Aaron.
quote: who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah

q: In which month of Elizabeth's pregnancy was the angel Gabriel sent to Mary?
why: John was about six months older than Jesus.
quote: In the sixth month, God sent the angel Gabriel

q: Who was governor of Syria during the census when Jesus was born?
why: It was the first census under him.
quote: while Quirinius was governor of Syria.

q: The angel Gabriel told Zechariah that he stands in the presence of whom?
why: He was sent with good news.
quote: I stand in the presence of God

q: How far had Jesus' parents traveled before they noticed the boy was missing?
why: They thought He was with relatives.
quote: they traveled on for a day before they began to look for Him

q: After His parents found Him in the temple, to which town did the boy Jesus return?
why: He was obedient to His parents.
quote: Then He went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them.

q: How much money did the Good Samaritan give the innkeeper?
why: He promised to pay any extra costs.
quote: The next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper.

q: In the Good Samaritan story, the traveler was going from Jerusalem to which city?
why: It was a dangerous road.
quote: A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho

q: In the prodigal son parable, what did the older brother say his father never gave him?
why: He felt his loyalty was ignored.
quote: Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.

q: In which city did Jesus meet Zacchaeus?
why: Jesus was passing through.
quote: Then Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.

q: In Luke, on which day was the Passover lamb to be sacrificed?
why: Jesus then sent Peter and John to prepare.
quote: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed.

q: In Luke, about which hour did darkness come over the land at the crucifixion?
why: It lasted until the ninth hour.
quote: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over all the land until the ninth hour.

q: Which women named in Luke told the apostles about the empty tomb?
why: Other women were with them too.
quote: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James

q: About how far was the village of Emmaus from Jerusalem?
why: The two disciples walked it on Easter day.
quote: about seven miles from Jerusalem.

q: At the end of Luke, as far as which village did Jesus lead His disciples before He was taken up?
why: There He lifted up His hands and blessed them.
quote: When Jesus had led them out as far as Bethany
